info.title: QualityGuard AI
info.description: AI-assisted industrial visual inspection: classification, anomaly detection, explainability, review workflow, analytics and reporting.

get.description: System health page: API, database, models, compute resources, storage and recent errors.
Status of outbound adapters (WebSocket, REST, webhook, MQTT; OPC UA / Modbus reported as not implemented).

post.description: Batch and folder inspection (the browser sends a selected folder's files with source=folder).

Attach an inspector annotation to the inspected image: a binary defect ``mask`` (PNG, same aspect as the
image; non-zero = defect), ``bbox`` boxes (data = {"boxes": [[x, y, w, h], ...]} in original pixels),
a ``polygon`` (data = {"points": [[x, y], ...]}) or a plain ``label``. Stored as ImageAnnotation rows with
source=inspector so curated datasets can include verified localisation.

get.description:
Pending reviews. ``order=priority`` ranks by active-learning value (see review_priority);
``oldest``/``newest`` by time. Every item carries its priority score and the reasons for it.

Anomaly Detection Center: the deployed thresholds and validated metrics of the profile's anomaly model
(read from its training record), plus the distribution of anomaly scores in stored inspections.

post.description: Deploy an APPROVED model version to a product profile (records a profile revision for rollback).

Create a product from photos of good items (>= 10, ideally 30+) and optional defective photos, then start
training its anomaly model in the background.

Add more photos and retrain as a new model version (the active version keeps serving until the new one is
approved and activated).

Approve the latest trained model of a custom product and make the product available for inspection
(creates or updates its profile - recorded as a profile revision, so it can be rolled back).
